[[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]] '''Kine''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] he was assigned by [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] to guard the [[Katarn estate]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. 

He participated in fights that the Imperials and [[mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] would bet on, even after the [[Stormtrooper_commander/Legends|Commander]] ordered them to stop.
